pick.headline: Clinic Resembling Urgent Care Discovers Billing Code for Emergency Room
pick.take: Nothing in medicine transforms faster than an urgent care visit in a building with the right billing designation. The waiting room is unchanged, but the facility fee is new, and the only emergency is the one arriving in the mail. Politicians call it affordability; the clinic calls it revenue cycle optimization.
